description: Formalizes protection of the 270 scored expository texts: permitted and prohibited uses, reference-distribution participation, validation reservation, circular-evaluation prevention with a conservative default rule, and reproducible protection keys.
scope: all evaluation and reference-distribution designs consuming this block

statements.statement: The 270 scored expository texts are a single protected evaluation block with reproducible protection keys.
The block may be used for evaluation and validation design of the target signal with a declared construction/evaluation source split.
The block's texts may participate in descriptive reference distributions as text features (research_only, statistics only, no score values).
Using the same scored block both to construct the target signal and to evaluate that signal is prohibited.
Using the scores to build reference norms for a measure later validated against the same scores is prohibited.
Score fields must never appear in reference distributions, membership artifacts, or the query boundary.
The block must never be split across development/evaluation boundaries.
No development use of the block without Research Evaluation approval.
Learner-facing raw display of the protected texts requires review and the D-08 display policy; default disabled.
No irreversible final train/dev/test partition is required unless scientifically justified; partitions must be versioned, reproducible, and leak-safe.
